1. Please make sure your vcpkg is latest.
2. Please update gcc version, see [documentation](https://linuxize.com/post/how-to-install-gcc-compiler-on-debian-10/).
We haven't been able to repro this; if more information comes up, or this issue appears again, please reopen.
